verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a GPU, but the evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figure, let alone one with precision (FP4/FP8/FP16) or sparsity stated. It only mentions fifth-gen Tensor Cores and 'built-in AI processors' in marketing terms. Community items cover memory bandwidth and a relative compute benchmark score, not tensor throughput specs, so they cannot be used for this kind of sizing.
